# L:// Red de tiendas · æ.store · llm.store

> Make something agents want. — Yael Mendez · Sovereign private client command prompt >_
> #ioa #internetofagents 🛸

> Stores are agentic environments. Agents propose; a human approves. This network is a lab by Yæl Méndez (LutheranInstitute).

Use this file to shop for a human. Everything is static JSON: no keys, no sign-in, no rate limits.

## How to buy a book for someone
1. Fetch the catalog: https://lutheraninstitute.github.io/bookstores/lab/gospel/agent/catalog.json
2. Match the person's request against title, category and summary. Categories: Biblias, Libros, Regalos, Joyas, Iglesia, Niños, Otros. Titles are mostly in Spanish.
3. Build a cart link from item ids: https://librosevangelicos.com/cart/ID:QTY,ID:QTY
4. Give the human the link. They review the real total and pay on the official store. Never pay for them.

## Environments
- [Network manifest](https://lutheraninstitute.github.io/bookstores/lab/ae.json): every store, its status and manifest
- [Gospel manifest](https://lutheraninstitute.github.io/bookstores/lab/gospel/ae.json): Laredo bookstore, real Shopify checkout, hours Mon–Sat 10:00–18:00 Central
- [teologia.ai manifest](https://lutheraninstitute.github.io/bookstores/lab/teologia.ai/gospel_bookstore/ae.json): Law and Gospel of the day + books per passage
- [Música manifest](https://lutheraninstitute.github.io/bookstores/lab/musica/ae.json): Latin Christian music, listen links only, no commerce

## Authority
Agents may: read, search, recommend, build carts and lists, open issues or PRs.
Only the human principal: prices, inventory, payments, merging to live.
